title: Common inlet pressure can hide a large hydraulic connection
statement: Two passages of resistance R with midpoint conductance g have Qcross=g(PA-PB)/(2+gR). At equal pressures the crossflow is zero for every g, so that test cannot certify independence. With PA=P,PB=0 and both outlets zero, diverted fraction2gR/(4+3gR)<=eta iff gR<=4eta/(2-3eta). At eta.01 this requires leak resistance>=49.25R. The zero-pressure B inlet must be able to receive flow; closing it changes the model.
